def forward(self, x, t, c):
        kp = c[:, :34].reshape(-1, 17, 2)
        mk = c[:, 34:51].reshape(-1, 17, 1)
        w = mk / mk.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1.0)
        cen = (kp * w).sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        kp = kp - cen
        scale = torch.sqrt(((kp ** 2).sum(dim=2, keepdim=True) * w).sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)).clamp(min=0.05)
        kp = kp / scale
        c = torch.cat([kp.reshape(-1, 34), c[:, 34:]], dim=1)
        h = torch.cat([x, c, sinusoidal(t)], dim=1)
        return self.out(self.blocks(self.inp(h)))
